answer: Per-action lease clearing requires each identity to prepay a nonrefundable $0.25 lease and a ten-minute memory-hard seal before its first action. A shared jetty throttles new leases per hardware root, so every extra identity needs a fresh root or a wait. The trellis admits only lease-backed actions and rejects duplicates. Refunds issue as shale credits that expire, keeping the marginal clone's expected payout strictly below its $0.25 plus CPU cost.
